footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Sunstone: after $16.4M attributable to noncontrolling interests. The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 6.0% to $960M in 2025. Gross margin was 60.1%, versus 61.1% a year earlier, and operating income fell 15.3% to $67.0M, a 7.0% margin.
Net income fell 70.4% to $8.2M, or $0.04 per share. Operating cash flow was $182M and free cash flow $78.7M, versus $13.0M; Sunstone returned $189M through dividends and buybacks.
sources: Sunstone Hotel Investors, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
